Insert Student Record Using JDBC
30
Easy
Write a Java program using JDBC to connect to a MySQL database and insert a student record into the students table.
The table has the following structure:
students(
   id INT,
   name VARCHAR(50),
   age INT
)
Read the student ID, name, and age from the user and insert the record into the database.
If the insertion is successful, display:
Student inserted successfully
Otherwise, display:
Insertion failed
